request.title: Death: the quiet end
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. This is a still for a cinematic trailer: keep the main subject centred slightly above the middle with a strong silhouette, and keep the lower third darker and uncluttered so a title can sit over it. Scene: the future where Nyxara won: a grey, silent wasteland where a sea of the undead stretches to the horizon under a dead sky, and a vast dead World Tree stands leafless in the middle distance. No colour left but grey and a faint violet haze.
request.alt: A sea of the undead to the horizon under a dead sky, a vast leafless World Tree in the distance.
